name: Hamor
overview: Hamor, also called Emmor, was the father of Shechem and a notable figure in early biblical history. Scripture records that Jacob purchased a parcel of land from the sons of Hamor, establishing a tangible connection between the patriarch and this Canaanite family (Genesis 33:19; Joshua 24:32; Acts 7:16). However, Hamor and his son Shechem were slain by Jacob's sons following the defilement of Dinah, illustrating the serious consequences of sin and the protection of God's covenant people (Genesis 34:26). The references to Hamor emphasize both his role in the land transactions and his tragic end, underscoring God's providence in preserving His chosen lineage.
